svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Against a control that got the same bacteria without the protectant
Hydroponic Arabidopsis under 100 mM NaCl — the only run with a strain-matched control
WB800 supernatant with no protectant is the control — same culture, same dilution,
so the protectant is the only difference between the two.
At 1/40, BoPEP4 was the only salted group that stayed near the unsalted range and stayed green.
One box per condition. A single run. We call it a proof of concept, not an effect size.
Our own wiki states the limit: both readouts are single plates with no technical replication, so the gap between 1/40 and the rest is what the run supports —
the ordering among 1/60, 1/80 and 1/100 is not.
